name: Black Sea
description: A paint with an animated pattern that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was only obtainable for 11 days from the "Dark Matter" bundle for UFO Day celebrations.
It was added to ultra containers on July 9th, 2021.

Unfortunately, the scintillating woven kevlar on this paint is still in the research and development phase, and so offers no bulletproof benefits. Other than distracting your enemy with its stunning beauty, of course.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
